speaker: Mr Alex Yam
text: asked the Minister for National Development (a) what the main reasons for the rejection of applications for HDB rental flats are; and (b) what HDB's projections for new rental flats in the next decade are.

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: One is with regard to a point on the citizenship criterion.

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: I think a number of Members in this House have mentioned this before, especially those who are undergoing a divorce and come from a Permanent Resident (PR) background, so the mother is a PR.

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: And because of the Court requirement to sell the flat, they then have an issue of housing their children, especially if they are young.

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: Does HDB guide these families in the process of application or point them in the right direction, especially if they do not qualify for a rental flat?

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: A second issue is with regard to the Joint Single Scheme where quite a number of people have also given feedback that they prefer to stay on their own.

speaker: Mr Alex Yam (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
text: What advice does HDB provide to them because they are unable to find an appropriate, related family member or friend to stay with them, but still prefer to stay on their own?

speaker: Ms Sun Xueling
text: On the second question, could I ask the Member to repeat, please?

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Members are encouraged to use the microphones where possible.
